🌲 - 🇱🇧 🇱🇧 Lebanese Forces leader Samir Geagea called on Lebanese authorities to expand the Batroun–Bsharri investigation to Hezbollah's military and security leadership. Following the prosecution of five Hezbollah members on charges involving the formation, recruitment, and arming of an unauthorized armed group, Geagea said that the detainees were part of Hezbollah's broader military and security apparatus rather than an independent cell. He urged authorities to summon those responsible for the organization's armed wing for questioning for operating outside state authority and endangering Lebanon's internal security.
